title: Cross‑functional roadmap: SAML SSO adoption, audit-log schema, and SOC2 evidence pipeline stabilization
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate milestone-level work across Product, Engineering, Security, and Legal to (1) roll out SAML SSO for enterprise customers, (2) define and deploy an audit-log schema and retention policy, and (3) stabilize the SOC2 evidence pipeline so that auditors can reliably pull historical artifacts. The goal is to deliver auditable evidence for key controls and a smooth SSO onboarding flow for early enterprise customers while minimizing production risk.
acceptance_criteria: SAML SSO: IdP metadata import, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows pass automated integration tests
Audit logs: JSON schema v1 published, indexed in logging system, and queryable by time-range + tenant ID
Evidence pipeline: automated snapshot export for selected controls (access reviews, config changes) and conformance report generation
Documentation: runbook for support, onboarding checklist, and compliance artifact mapping completed
Stakeholder signoff: Security and Legal sign off on retention policy and evidence controls
milestones: Milestone 1 - SAML SSO basic: IdP metadata UI + test harness (2026-03-15)
Milestone 2 - Audit log schema v1 + retention policy (2026-03-28)
Milestone 3 - Evidence pipeline prototype for control AC-2 & CM-3 (2026-04-12)
Milestone 4 - Canary onboarding with two enterprise customers (2026-04-25)
Milestone 5 - Audit readiness review with external auditor (2026-04-30)
tasks: Finalize SAML metadata import UX and backend endpoint
Add tenant_id and request_id to every audit event; define enumerated event types
Add retention and legal-hold flag to log storage lifecycle
Build an automated export job that bundles artifacts for a control and stores with checksum
Add canary customer onboarding checklist and run initial onboarding
Instrument console with per-tenant evidence access audit
progress_updates: 2026-02-20: Kickoff with Security, Legal, and Infra; mapped control owners and agreed success criteria
2026-02-28: Engineering spike completed for SAML library options; chose passport-saml fork with patched cert handling
2026-03-03: Draft audit-log JSON schema circulated; Legal requested additional fields for subpoena tracking
2026-03-08: CI tests for SP-initiated SSO passing in staging (3/4 IdP samples)
2026-03-12: Evidence export prototype exports control bundles to S3 with checksums; awaiting retention policy signoff
risks: Incomplete event coverage - some internal flows may not emit tenant_id causing gaps
Retention policy conflicts with regional data laws (EU/UK) may require per-region exceptions
Onboarding complexity could delay enterprise customers and increase support load
External auditor timelines could expose schedule slippage during review
mitigations: Add gating QA step that validates tenant_id and request_id presence in sampling pipeline
Engage Legal to produce per-region retention matrix and add feature flag for region-specific retention
Prepare a lightweight SSO concierge onboarding offering: config checklist + engineer timeboxed support
Schedule interim readiness demo with auditor and capture feedback early; shift lower-risk milestones earlier
estimate_notes: 13 points - includes 5 engineering sprints and two legal review cycles
qa_plan: Automated SAML flows across 4 IdP samples; audit log ingestion e2e test; evidence export integrity checks; runbook sanity test with support team
customer_impact_notes: High for enterprise onboarding. Customers in the pilot will have temporary onboarding windows; public API unaffected. Audit readiness reduces churn risk for regulated customers.
